observations: Initial targeted run: 72 tests, 7 failures. Two newly added probes collected a full stack at each checkpoint and consumed the local time slice. The final probe observes only target hashing during certification; ordinary solver checkpoints carry no stack-inspection cost. Original small-deadline failures were retained.

Initial full run stopped after 342 tests with a test-executor exit -1 and connection reset, after one existing CP-SAT shared-seed refill assertion failure. That run did not produce a completed new XML report.

Separate baseline/candidate probes passed four existing budget cases in both versions; the one-second material-8089 test passed baseline and timed out candidate in that probe, while passing the first full run. Timing cause was not proven.

The 4096-branch trillion-quantity baseline returned one incomplete measured plan and one incomplete warmup without the budget-exhausted flag. Candidate measured plans and warmups were all complete. No performance percentage is claimed for this unequal-completion comparison.
Ordinary chain/session timing increased in this batch, with essentially unchanged allocation; these raw observations are retained and are not presented as an improvement.
A helper regression compilation initially missed its fixture classpath and was corrected; no production code was changed by that correction.

The second full attempt observed 952 tests (946 passed, 5 failed, 1 skipped) before ending without a build footer/new complete XML report. Failures included two legacy topology cancellation probes tied to HashMap.merge; the compact implementation requires observing its actual traversal checkpoints instead.

A separate 53-test verification completed with 25 failures, including CP-SAT INVALID results and an intermittent newly added cancellation probe. Both baseline and candidate subsequently reproduced missing OR-Tools JNI bindings even with an isolated native search directory. That failure is outside the changed V2 certification path and remains unresolved.

The system volume later had about 7 MiB free; Gradle cache packing and daemon startup failed. Only regenerable build-cache entries were removed. Final material verification and release-jar checks then passed; JNI bindings still failed in both versions after space recovery, so disk pressure is not a proven root cause of that error.

Expanded verification completed 1249 tests: 1208 passed, 40 failed, 1 optional EAEP skip. Its temporary filter excluded CpSat* classes only in the main planner test package, so other CP-SAT call sites still ran. Full-suite validation is not claimed; all failing cases and messages are included in validation.expanded_validation.
